description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript): implement scoring and validation for a three-rolls-per-frame bowling variant from a stub and an instructions file - strikes, spares made on the second or third roll, open frames of three rolls, tenth-frame bonus rolls on fresh lanes, exact error messages and rejected rolls that must not be recorded. A memorised ten-pin solution fails the three-roll frames. The node:test suite is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
